echo "=== 1. Containers ==="; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
echo; echo "=== 2. Frontend :3000 ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET / -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
echo; echo "=== 3. Backend API :8000 ==="; curl -s -w " -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8000/api/health
echo; echo "=== 4. WebUI :3333 ==="; curl -s -w " -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 http://localhost:3333/health
echo; echo "=== 5. IPFS API :5001 ==="; curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/version
echo; echo "=== 6. IPFS Cluster :9094 ==="; curl -s http://localhost:9094/version
echo; echo "=== 7. Pinning service :9097 ==="; curl -s -w " -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:9097/
echo; echo "=== 8. DB ==="; ls -la /workspace/volumes/db/truspace.db
